summary: Iteration 8 validates the two big user-requested changes: (1) FIX-1 — PhotoStore migration that gets legacy devices out of the 'quota exceeded' crash, and (2) FIX-2 — account system (phone + 4-digit PIN + EFYL-XXXXXX + JWT + /restore). BACKEND: 23/23 tests pass in test_efyl_v5_account.py against the public preview URL. Register happy-path (fresh phone, OTP mock 123456) returns {user_id, efyl_id (EFYL-XXXXXX, 11 chars), name, phone, token(JWT)}; invalid PIN → 400; duplicate → 409; bad OTP → 401. Login accepts +237699000111, '+237 6 99 00 01 11' (spaces tolerated), EFYL-90AF88, EFYL-90AF88 lowercase, all with PIN 1234 → same JWT-carrying response. Wrong PIN returns 401 'Invalid credentials' (generic), unknown identifier → 401 (no enumeration), 5 wrong PINs then correct PIN → 429 lockout confirmed. GET /api/restore: no token → 401, garbage token → 401, valid token → {user (pin_hash STRIPPED), addresses (with photos array), surveys}; seed address FOT-A-001-777 present with 1 photo. POST /api/sync bulk with photos+photos_count round-trips correctly and GET /addresses/{id} reflects photos_count. Regression: /addresses (list), /admin/overview?pin=237237, /surveys/{id} 404 all green. FRONTEND (Expo web, 390x844): (A) SATURATED LEGACY DEVICE — pre-seeded localStorage 'efyl:addresses' with 2 addresses each holding a 500KB base64 photo (total ~1.0MB) then reloaded the app → startup migratePhotosOut() shrank localStorage to 795 bytes, set photos:null / photo_base64:null / photos_count:1 on each address, populated IndexedDB db 'efyl_photos' store 'photos' with keys ['LEGACY-001','LEGACY-002'] and full 512000-char base64 preserved, and the /address/LEGACY-001 detail page rendered '📸 PHOTOS (1)' with the correct bearing (45°) and lat/lng (4.10000, 9.70000) proving PhotoStore hydration works end-to-end. NO app crash. (B) AUTH LOGIN — /login shows auth-choice with auth-register-card + auth-login-card + guest-btn; wrong PIN on +237699000111 → French 'Identifiant ou PIN incorrect' via [data-testid=auth-error]; correct PIN 1234 → navigates to tabs, profile-efyl-id shows '🪪 EFYL-90AF88 • +237699000111', name 'Testeur Fotouni', 'Se déconnecter' button visible, and localStorage 'efyl:addresses' now contains FOT-A-001-777 merged with the 5 pre-seeded demo addresses → RESTORE merged server data into local. (C) REGISTER — reg-name/reg-phone/reg-pin/reg-pin2 with mismatched PINs → 'Les deux PIN ne correspondent pas'; fixed pin2 + reg-send-otp-btn → reg-otp-input appears; entering 123456 + reg-submit-btn → efyl-id-box shows 'EFYL-09273E'; reg-start-btn → tabs; profile shows 'Test User E2E' + '🪪 EFYL-09273E • +237687044024'. (D) GUEST + ADMIN — guest-btn → tabs (onboarding on first launch as expected), /admin PIN 237237 → admin-dashboard renders with stats (273 total, 36 today, 269 week, 10 active, 54 surveys, 37 persons) and 4-row by_type breakdown. Deprecated packages: none of expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch found. RN Web style-prop warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) unchanged from iteration 7 — pre-existing.

react_native_issues.issue: Persistent RN Web deprecation warnings unchanged from iteration 7: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' deprecated (use textShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), Animated: useNativeDriver JS-fallback warning. Not caused by this batch. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme/index.ts (Shadows tokens).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:684-697 GET /api/restore returns the full user document minus pin_hash — but still exposes locked_until, failed_pin_attempts and last_login. Not critical (user is authenticated), but the response schema should be explicit (Pydantic ResponseModel) rather than a raw dict projection to prevent accidental future leaks.

server.py:60 user_id_for_phone strips '+' and spaces but does NOT strip other separators like '-' or '(' → login identifier normalization (server.py:646) uses .isdigit() which is safer. Register vs login normalization should share the same normalize_phone() helper to avoid drift. Currently register calls normalize_phone() but user_id_for_phone() does its own replace() — the paths happen to align because normalize_phone() already produced digits-only phone, but it's fragile.

server.py:558 _consume_otp deletes the OTP code on success — good — but in register (line 618), if the subsequent bcrypt.hashpw() or update_one raises, the OTP is already consumed and the user must go through the 3/10min rate limit again. Consider ordering: hash PIN FIRST, then _consume_otp, then upsert user, so a hash exception doesn't burn an OTP.

photoStore.ts uses in-memory fallback when IndexedDB is missing on web — but this fallback is per-tab and NOT persisted across reloads. If a device loses IDB support the migration will 'succeed' silently but photos will vanish on next reload. Consider logging a warning to the app (Alert + telemetry) when hasIDB is false.

AppContext.tsx:48-92 migratePhotosOut swallows ALL exceptions silently ('migration must never block app startup'). This is correct as UX policy but means we have no observability when migration fails. Consider recording a boolean flag in Storage.getPrefs() {photoMigrationRan: true, photoMigrationFailed?: string} so we can detect stuck devices.

success_rate.backend: 100% — 23/23 tests pass in test_efyl_v5_account.py (Register 4, Login 7, Restore 3, Sync 3, Regression 5, Health 1). Combined with prior suites: full backend regression still green.
success_rate.frontend: 100% of user-visible items verified on Expo web at 390x844: (a) legacy-device quota migration end-to-end (1MB localStorage → 795 bytes, IndexedDB populated, detail page renders migrated photo meta), (b) auth-choice screen (register/login/guest cards), (c) wrong-PIN French error via auth-error testID, (d) correct login → tabs + profile shows Testeur Fotouni + EFYL-90AF88, (e) /api/restore merged FOT-A-001-777 into localStorage 'efyl:addresses', (f) register happy-path with fresh phone → efyl-id-box shows EFYL-XXXXXX → profile shows new user, (g) PIN mismatch shows 'Les deux PIN ne correspondent pas', (h) guest-btn → tabs regression, (i) /admin PIN 237237 → dashboard.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests registered fresh accounts under unique phone numbers derived from time.time() and cleaned up transient addresses. Persistent seed +237699000111 / PIN 1234 / EFYL-90AF88 was NOT touched. Frontend register test created a new account under +2376XXXXXXXX (unique per run) — this account persists in the users collection but is harmless (uses generic name 'Test User E2E').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public backend base = https://efyl-address-book.preview.emergentagent.com/api. OTP mock code = 123456 (rate limit 3/10min per phone → generate fresh phones per test via `+2376{int(time.time())%10**8:08d}`). Existing account: +237699000111 / PIN 1234 / EFYL-90AF88 / name 'Testeur Fotouni' → owner_id=user_237699000111, seed address FOT-A-001-777 with 1 photo. JWT is HS256 with backend/.env JWT_SECRET (default fallback = 'efyl-dev-secret-change-me' — override via env for prod). /api/restore expects `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; response strips pin_hash but still contains locked_until/failed_pin_attempts/last_login. FRONTEND critical testIDs — auth choice: auth-register-card, auth-login-card, guest-btn, auth-back-btn. Register: reg-name, reg-phone, reg-pin, reg-pin2, reg-send-otp-btn, reg-otp-input, reg-submit-btn, efyl-id-box, reg-start-btn. Login: login-identifier, login-pin, login-submit-btn. Errors: auth-error. Profile: profile-efyl-id, logout-btn. Photo migration: db 'efyl_photos' store 'photos' — key=address_id, value=AddressPhoto[]. localStorage key 'efyl:addresses' MUST stay slim (photos:null, photo_base64:null, photos_count:N). Migration runs at AppContext startup (AppContext.tsx:109 await migratePhotosOut()). If IDB is unavailable, PhotoStore falls back to per-tab in-memory Map (photos lost on reload) — this is a silent limitation flagged in critical_code_review_comments.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found. Migration + auth work as specified.
